title: UsageReceipt v1
description: Normalized resource receipt for one physical model call. Carries a REQUIRED trust tier. `chargedTokens` and `chargedCostMicroUsd` are NEVER null: when telemetry is absent the charged values are the published tier ceiling. The silent-zero gap (Inbox action-pilot always reported unavailable/cost 0; JobTrack validateUsage accepts floor-0 receipts with no trust tier) is closed by a CODE-SIDE invariant, not by this schema: for trust in {estimated_tier_ceiling, unavailable} each consumer's validator MUST require chargedTokens>=1 AND chargedCostMicroUsd>=1 (config-pinned non-null floor, freeze resolution #7). This schema's `minimum:0` still admits {trust:'unavailable',chargedTokens:0,chargedCostMicroUsd:0}; the floor lives in CONVENTIONS §5. Observed values are null ONLY when trust does not carry that observation.

trust.description: provider_signed: cryptographically attested by the provider (requires `signature`). provider_reported: provider returned usage but unsigned. estimated_tier_ceiling: no trustworthy telemetry; charged the exact published per-attempt ceiling. unavailable: no adapter plumbed provider usage AND no ceiling applies (charged values are still non-null, set by the caller's own floor policy).

signature.description: Opaque provider-signed-receipt token. Present ONLY when trust=provider_signed. Never grants authority; it is verified out of band. See OPEN DECISION on signature format.

allOf.description: estimated_tier_ceiling and unavailable carry no observed telemetry.
provider_reported and provider_signed must carry at least one observed value.
A signature is present exactly when trust=provider_signed.
